description: The integration test failures of an image whose server cannot start a child process, such as the ppgdc no-child-process image started by container/run.sh with TermdbTest. Except for the entries whose reason says that they also time out, each entry failed only in that image, and not in a run of the same build with R, python and child processes; its reason is the tool that its request needs. Use with PP_EXPECTED_FAILURES=test/expectedFailures.nocp.json, see test/puppet.js.
